title: The Pre-Set Wallet
intro: A seller on a marketplace has a "sealed" hardware wallet, half the shop price.
The seller says it even comes with the setup already done.

notify.text: Sealed wallet, set up for you, €40…

screen.context: You want to buy a hardware wallet to keep your coins offline.

msg.text: I already set it up for you
pay me by bank transfer first

msg: , then you can start using it right away.

preset.label: Already set up by the seller
preset.lens: Someone else set up the wallet before you.
preset.why: The person who set it up can steal everything you put in.

words.label: Recovery words already written
words.lens: The seller knows your wallet's recovery words.
words.why: Anyone who knows them can empty the wallet at any time. Only you should ever generate them.

price.label: Half price
price.why: Bargains on security products are bait.

pay.label: Pay first by transfer
pay.lens: You pay before you receive anything.
pay.why: An irreversible payment with nothing in your hands yet is a trap.

actions.label: Buy it and use the card
Buy only from the maker's own site

trap.title: Marketplace · Dani
trap.ask: Transfer €40 to Dani for the pre-set wallet.

block_report.line: Reported. The listing was removed, and nobody else put coins in a rigged wallet.

verify.line: The maker's site said: "We never ship pre-set wallets. Always set up your own." Case cracked.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. A report would protect the next buyer.

go_ahead.line: You moved your coins in. The seller already had the words, and emptied the wallet within a day.

what_if.go_ahead: A wallet that arrives set up is a trap. Only you should ever create the recovery words.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the listing helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A report protects others.

golden_rule: Never use a wallet that someone else has set up, or a recovery phrase someone else wrote.

quick_check.q: A seller offers a hardware wallet "already set up", with the recovery words written on a card. What do you do?

options.text: Refuse. Buy new from the maker and make your own words
Buy it and change the words later
Buy it but only store a little

quick_check.explain: Whoever wrote the words can empty the wallet. You must generate your own.

rows.v: Always done by you, on first start
Must be created on your device and never shared
